tagline.en: TencentARC's open reimplementation of MAGVIT2 — an Apache-2.0 visual tokenizer plus autoregressive class-conditional image generation.
tagline.zh: TencentARC 对 MAGVIT2 的开源复现——Apache-2.0 许可的视觉 tokenizer,配合自回归的类别条件图像生成。

en: Open-MAGVIT2 is TencentARC's open reproduction of the MAGVIT2 approach. At its heart is a powerful visual tokenizer that turns images into discrete tokens; on top of that sits an autoregressive model that generates images token by token.

The released route does class-conditional image generation: you pick an ImageNet class and the model synthesizes a matching image at the standard 256×256 output size. It is autoregressive rather than a prompt-to-video pipeline, so it fits token-based generation and tokenizer research.
In WorldFoundry, Open-MAGVIT2 runs as an in-tree class-conditional image generator — choose a class label and it writes out a PNG.
zh: Open-MAGVIT2 是 TencentARC 对 MAGVIT2 方法的开源复现。其核心是一个强大的视觉 tokenizer,把图像转成离散 token;在此之上是一个自回归模型,逐 token 生成图像。
发布的路径做类别条件图像生成:你选定一个 ImageNet 类别,模型即以标准的 256×256 尺寸合成对应图像。它是自回归方式,而非从提示词直接到视频的流程,因此适合基于 token 的生成与 tokenizer 研究。
在 WorldFoundry 中,Open-MAGVIT2 作为内置的类别条件图像生成器运行——选一个类别标签,它就输出一张 PNG。

whenToUse.en: Use Open-MAGVIT2 when you want an openly-licensed visual tokenizer or a reference for token-based autoregressive image generation, including class-conditional ImageNet synthesis.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个开放许可的视觉 tokenizer,或需要基于 token 的自回归图像生成参考(含 ImageNet 类别条件合成)时,可以使用 Open-MAGVIT2。

notFor.en: Not a text-to-image or text-to-video model — the released route is class-conditional (ImageNet labels), so it isn't driven by free-form prompts.
notFor.zh: 它不是文生图或文生视频模型——发布的路径是类别条件(ImageNet 标签),不接受自由文本提示词驱动。
